line.name: Lampert Limitada
line.background_text: Limitada is Lampert Cigars' annual limited-edition retailer-exclusive series, launched in 2022 as part of the 'Golden Retailer Program' with a Salomones vitola. Founder Dr. Stefan Lampert releases a new Limitada blend most years for the brand's top retail accounts, each edition typically using a different wrapper/binder/filler combination and vitola. CONFIRMED as a genuinely distinct, standalone line from Ocean Breeze - no source describes Limitada as a variant/edition of Ocean Breeze; both are documented on lampertcigars.com as separate product pages with different blends, vitolas, and release cadences. (A few 'Limitada_Pack-Sleeve' photo files are mixed into our Mac's Ocean Breeze folder - likely just an asset-organization quirk, not evidence of a product relationship.)

vitolas.summary_review: Debuted July 2022 as part of the Golden Retailer Program, aged at least a year before release; 500 boxes (5,000 cigars) produced.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: PCA 2022: 7.5x58 Salomones, Ecuador Habano wrapper, Nicaraguan binder/filler, $30/cigar, aged at least a year, 500 boxes.

vitolas.summary_review: Handmade in Costa Rica using Ecuador Criollo 98 wrapper and Brazilian binder/filler; billed as a full-bodied international debut shown at PCA 2024.
The brand's first box-pressed release; Ecuadorian Habano Vuelta Abajo dark wrapper over Ecuadorian Habano 2000 binder with Brazil/Dominican/Nicaragua filler, limited to 500 boxes.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: 6x54 box-pressed Toro, $18/cigar, 500 boxes of 10 (200 US / 300 international), rolled at Tabacos de Costa Rica.

vitolas.summary_review: 2026 edition: Ecuadorian Connecticut-seed wrapper, Habano 2000 binder, DR/Ecuador/Nicaragua (Jalapa) filler; $19.50/cigar, released August 2026.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: 6x54 box-pressed Toro, $19.50/cigar, Tabacos de Costa Rica factory, released Aug 10 2026.

research_notes: Investigated the Ocean Breeze/Limitada overlap specifically: Ocean Breeze's own vitolas (Gordito, Robusto Grande, Toro Grande) do NOT match any Limitada vitola/blend, and no source describes Limitada as a variant of Ocean Breeze. Conclusion: Limitada is a genuinely separate, standalone line. Exact length/ring gauge for the 2023 Toro could not be confirmed beyond the size name.
